description_en: Fourśikharatemples originally part of apańcadevalacomplex and dating from approximately 14th-15th century.The monuments are found in the southern part of the Bhurtī Temple Complex. The site itself is located in the northern end of the settlement of Bhurtī, 3 km north of Narayana, the district headquarters. It currently comprises 22 standingśikharatemples (ordevala) and one stone fountain. Architectural activity at the site can be situated between the 13thand 15thcentury, a time period corresponding to the latter part of the Khaśa Malla empire and the early phase of the Rāskoṭi dynasty (Andolfatto 2019,Pokharel 2011: 128-129,Sharma 1972: 23-31,Sharma 2012: 120-123).In 2008, the “Bhurti Temple Complex of Dailekh” was enlisted on UNESCO’s World Heritage Tentative List by the Government of Nepal (criteriaiiandiv).The four monuments were originally part of apańcadevalaplan. Oneśikharatemples was lost since the construction of the temples. This is attested by the organisation of the other temples and similar to that of the nearby Pañcadevala 1 (DLK0012).Thepañcadevalaplan is mostly found in the districts of Dailekh, Achham and Kalikot, which corresponds to the area controlled by the Rāskoṭi kings. This dynasty ruled between the end of the 14th century and the end of the 18th century. In the absence of epigraphic records it is possible to date the Bhurtī Pañcadevala 1 between the 14th and the 15th century.Thispańcadevalacomplex stands out amidst theśikharaarchitecture of the Karnali Basin for the carvings ornamenting the upper part of the central temple's pediment (Skt.śukanāsikā). It shows a temple-like motif surrounded by volutes. Another particularity is that the sanctum of the central temple (001) contains a central circular cavity that, according to local informants, was interpreted by Yogi Naraharinatha as the place of akamala cakraand not of aśivaliṅga(reference needed).
description_ne: यो सम्पदा शिखर शैलीमा बनाइएका पाँचवटा देवलहरूको समूह हो र यो भुर्तीबाट उत्तरतर्फको क्षेत्रमा र जिल्ला सदरमुकाम नारायणबाट करीब ३ किलोमिटर टाढा अवस्थित छ । यो पुरातात्त्विक सम्पदा ईशाको चौधौंदेखि पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीभित्र बनाइएको हुनुपर्दछ । भुर्ती मन्दिर पसिरमा २२ शिखर मन्दिरहरू र एउटा ढुङ्गे धारा छन् । सन् २००८ मा यो मन्दिर परिसरलाई नेपाल सरकारले UNESCO’s World Heritage को ‘tentative list’ मा सूचीकृत गरेको थियो ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired), Restored, Rebuilt
